title: Trouble Understanding and Activating Features
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe customers having difficulty understanding, locating, or activating vehicle features, with most examples lacking enough context for a clear sentiment label.

mixed.summary: One mixed review notes difficulty finding vehicle computer mileage controls because the interface differs from the customer's prior vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe trouble activating the eSIM, understanding tech, radio, and driver-assistance features, finding interior storage, and an unspecified feature that does not always activate.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so sentiment conclusions are limited.
Several examples are brief or lack outcome context, making it unclear whether they reflect dissatisfaction, confusion during onboarding, or resolved issues.
The topic mixes different subjects including feature activation, control discoverability, system understanding, and storage usability.
